thread:
Sasha: Heads-up 1: recorded Sparrow Q&A yesterday. Need to finalize quotes, social snippets, and the webinar speaker list. Uploads in the folder: https://drive.redwood/sparrow/recordings-174503

Diego: I skimmed the transcript. Good soundbites around 2:30 and 9:10. They call out a 58% cost drop for one workload and a 64% drop for another we should standardize how we report it.

Priya: Drafted two headline options and four tweet-length snippets. Also put together UTM and CTA recommendations: utm_campaign=sparrow-spotlight, cta=trial-or-audit. Link: https://docs.redwood/sparrow/marketing-174503

Maya: Legal: confirm what we can publish w/o attestation. Also, Sparrow asked for a short embargo window (48h) for their exec team to review.

Legal Team: We need either a signed attestation for the metric delta or to phrase it as a range/approximate. Also require signed media release for audio/video clips. We'll send a release template via contracts-bot.

Sam (growth): For lead routing: can we map leads to SDR queues by 'inference scale' and 'industry'? If so, we'll add pre-qual fields on the blog form.

Sasha: Good. Recommend fields: company size, estimated RPS, primary model type. Keep it 5 fields max.

Diego: Also thinking of a short technical appendix describing the test harness and quantization settings used. That will help engineering-minded readers and reduce back-and-forth with customers.

Priya: I'll add the appendix as a collapsible section in the blog and a PDF appendix for the webinar deck. Also prepping a 30s podcast snippet for our podcast channel. Need clearance to post audio clip on Apple/Spotify.

contracts-bot: Media_Release_Template_Sparrow_v1.docx uploaded to /legal/sparrow/ 1 awaiting signature.

Maya: Timeline proposal: internal preview Fri EOD, sign-off Mon 10am PT, public publish Tue, webinar Thurs. Is that too tight?

Sam (growth): Tight but doable if we get the signed release by Mon morning. Also request dedicated UTM for webinar registration and a separate landing page to test conversion variants.

Legal Team: We'll prioritize review. If Sparrow returns signed attestation for both workload measurements, we'll allow the explicit 58%/64% numbers with context in the appendix. If not, switch to 'reduced inference spend by ~60% across selected workloads'.

Sasha: Noted. @Diego can you annotate the transcript with the exact phrasing Sparrow used? We should avoid paraphrasing numbers.

Diego: Done 1 highlighted quotes and attached snippet filenames: sparrow_02_30.wav, sparrow_09_10.wav.

Priya: Social plan: 1 hero LinkedIn post, 3 short tweets, 2 LinkedIn variations for targeted vertical audiences. Also two social card art concepts (technical and business). Need final quote text + logo approval from Sparrow.

Maya: I'll request logo/brand usage and the signature on the release. Also asking Sparrow if they want to co-present on the webinar (they usually do).

contracts-bot: Sparrow_signed_release_1745050000.pdf uploaded to /legal/sparrow (signed).

Legal Team: Received signed release. Please attach Sparrow's attestation (if provided) before publishing. If attestation is missing, revert to approximate phrasing per our earlier note.

Sasha: Amy (Sparrow) replied in DM: can provide attestation for the '58% and 64%' numbers, with measurement windows and the sample size. She requested a short embargo until Tue noon PT.

Priya: Great. I'll swap in the exact figures and add the measurement windows link in the appendix. Also creating two CTA variants: 'Start free trial' and 'Request technical audit'.

Sam (growth): We'll run both CTAs in the landing A/B test and route demo requests to 'SDR-Inference' queue while audits go to 'Solutions-Architect'. Also adding lead tag: 'sparrow-spotlight-2024'.

Diego: Web webinar logistics: Sparrow will send a speaker bio + slide 1 (company overview). We should get their slides 48h before the webinar to QA for brand compliance.

Maya: Agreed. Final approvals timeline: Legal sign-off done, Sparrow will send attestation + logos by Mon EOD. Marketing to lock copy + assets by Mon midnight. Publish Tue 11:00 PT, webinar Thu 10:00 PT.

Priya: I'll post the draft hero copy for review in the doc by 9am Mon. Please comment inline.

Sasha: :thumbsup: I'm good with the asset list. Diego, can you produce the 15s and 60s cuts for social?

Diego: Yup. Will deliver mp3s and waveform previews by Monday. Filenames: sparrow_social_15s.mp3, sparrow_social_60s.mp3.

Sam (growth): One more ask: track MQL->SQL conversion specifically for this campaign; I'll add a Bayes monitor on the dashboard.

Maya: Perfect. If no blockers, we'll proceed to lock the calendar and set up the webinar registration page. Please react with :eyes: if you're still reviewing, :thumbsup: to approve.

Priya: :eyes:

Diego: :thumbsup:

Sam (growth): :thumbsup:

Legal Team: :thumbsup:

Maya: Thanks all. I'll post the final publish checklist and tag everyone once Sparrow's attestation and logos are in.

(End thread)
